description: A jQuery plugin for rendering pie charts using the Flot charting library. It includes features for customizing pie appearance, labels, interactivity, and supports donut charts. The code contains plugin initialization, configuration options, drawing routines, and event handling for hover and click interactions.

methods.name: checkPieEnabled
methods.description: Checks if pie chart rendering is enabled in options and sets up necessary hooks.

methods.name: bindEvents
methods.description: Binds mousemove and click events for interactivity if hoverable and clickable options are enabled.

methods.name: calcTotal
methods.description: Calculates the total sum of data values for pie slices.

methods.name: processDatapoints
methods.description: Processes data points before drawing, including combining slices if needed.

methods.name: setupPie
methods.description: Calculates maximum radius and center position for the pie chart.

methods.name: fixData
methods.description: Ensures data is in correct format for rendering.

methods.name: combine
methods.description: Combines small slices into a single 'Other' slice based on threshold.

methods.name: draw
methods.description: Main drawing function that renders the pie chart, slices, labels, and shadows.

methods.name: drawDonutHole
methods.description: Draws the inner hole for donut charts.

methods.name: isPointInPoly
methods.description: Determines if a point is inside a polygon, used for hit detection.

methods.name: findNearbySlice
methods.description: Finds which pie slice is near a given mouse position for interactivity.

methods.name: onMouseMove
methods.description: Handles mouse move events for hover interactions.

methods.name: onClick
methods.description: Handles click events on the pie chart.

methods.name: triggerClickHoverEvent
methods.description: Triggers hover or click events and manages highlighting.

methods.name: unhighlight
methods.description: Removes highlight from a pie slice.

methods.name: indexOfHighlight
methods.description: Finds index of a highlighted slice.

methods.name: drawOverlay
methods.description: Draws overlay effects such as highlights on slices.
